# Clockd

> Grocery price scanner for iPhone. Snap a shelf tag and see if the price is worth it — then buy or walk.

## Product
- Name: Clockd AI Scanner
- Platform: iOS (iPhone / iPad)
- URL: https://www.getclockdapp.com
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clockd-ai-scanner/id6772232502
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/getclockdapp/

## Core value
One photo answers: is this shelf price a deal? Clockd shows a deal signal, typical price range, and online comps (Amazon, Walmart, Target). Results are AI estimates, not live register prices.

## Also included
- Grocery list compare across nearby stores
- Flip: resale range and profit estimate on the same scan
- Receipt trips: log store, line items, and total after checkout

## Pricing
Free to download with a daily analysis limit. Clockd Pro unlocks a higher daily limit and ad-free analyzing. No credit card required to download.
